column1: # **A lottery on the arms shop's barks.** `shops.md` Section 8.A's shared
# closing envelope draws "one of four `SHOPPE.DAT` records from the current
# shop-kind" row, and the entry greeting draws from its own pool the same way.
# `prng.md` Section 3 seeds the two sides from the host clock, so which member
# of a pool each side draws is not comparable and the beats that carry one have
# measured nothing - they must be re-run rather than read as differences.
# `shop-arms-menus` and `shop-arms-sell` already carry this note; measured
# 2026-09-12 this scenario draws from the same pools and did not.
# The arms shop's Buy menu, reached by walking in at 10:00.
# **A second lottery: where the weaponsmith stands.** At 10:00 the resident
# wanders around its waypoint (`npc-schedules.md` §9 value `4`; pinned by
# `tests_inline/town_fight_followups.rs`, `p15_*`), so on arrival it is east
# of the party in some runs and a cell away in others, and the Look/Talk beats
# then read `a merchant` or `cobble`, a greeting bark or `Nobody's here!`. The
# stock side does both from the same seed and keys: measured 2026-10-16 over
# the `look` beat of every capture since 2026-09-18 - `a merchant` in
# `look`/`talk`/`after-space` difference whose map shows the resident in a
# different cell has measured this roll, not the engine.
# requires-seed: the party outside Britain on the overworld at 10:00
# (see the README) - it compares nothing. `town-talk-after-entry` walks in and
# reaches the same weaponsmith at 12:39, when it is sitting on a chair, and the
# stock refuses the trigger with a fixed merchant line while the engine opens
# the overlay (u5-engine#15, u5-spec#214). This scenario is the control for
# that one: same town, same resident (`.NPC` dialog byte 0x81), same walk-in
# entry path, but seeded at 10:00, when the resident stands on cobbles rather
# than at a table. If the stock enters the shop here the refusal is a state
# gate; if it refuses here too, the gate is something else. Route from
# `talk_gate_probe --script e --chase 129`, which re-plans after every step so
# schedule drift during the walk is accounted for.
# requires-seed: the party outside Britain on the overworld at 10:00, so the scenario can walk in through the door
